name: Lor'danel Landing
summary: Lor'danel Landing designates a stretch of northern Darkshore's coastline along Mist's Edge, sitting just west of the night elven settlement of Lor'danel. In this era, it remains an untamed northern shore of the Veiled Sea under the watchful watch of the local night elves.

sections.title: The Northern Shoreline
sections.body: Situated at the northern limits of Darkshore, the strand known as Lor'danel Landing borders the misty waters of the Veiled Sea along Mist's Edge. The surrounding territory is ancient night elf land, closely situated to the small haven of Lor'danel and shielded by the wild, fog-draped forests of northern Kalimdor. Travelers wandering these reaches find cold sand, crashing waves, and the ever-vigilant presence of Sentinel scouts keeping watch against outside intrusion.

faq.answer: Lor'danel Landing is located in far northern Darkshore, running along the coastline of Mist's Edge directly west of the settlement of Lor'danel on the Veiled Sea.

faq.q: Who controls this stretch of coast?
aliases: is lordanel landing horde or alliance
faq.answer: The land falls firmly within night elven territory. The Sentinels of Darnassus watch over northern Darkshore, and the nearby settlement of Lor'danel serves as a haven for the kaldorei and the Alliance.

faq.q: What threats can be found near Lor'danel Landing?
faq.answer: Beyond natural coastland wildlife and stray sea creatures washed ashore by the tides of the Veiled Sea, northern Darkshore is regularly menaced by aggressive reef scavengers, furbolgs, and coastal beasts.

angles.text: The strand safeguards the approaches to northern Darkshore and stands as a peaceful threshold of ancient kaldorei coastal domain.
Positioned just across the water from Teldrassil, this coastal shore helps secure the perimeter around Lor'danel and the northern sea routes.
